Definition: to open, i.e. be (causatively, make) roomy; usually figuratively (in a mental or moral sense) to be (causatively, make) simple or (in a sinister way) delude
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be spacious, be open, be wide; 1a) (Qal) to be spacious or open or wide; 1b) (Hiphil) to make spacious, make open; 2) to be simple, entice, deceive, persuade; 2a) (Qal); 2a1) to be open-minded, be simple, be naive; 2a2) to be enticed, be deceived; 2b) (Niphal) to be deceived, be gullible; 2c) (Piel); 2c) (Piel); 2c1) to persuade, seduce; 2c2) to deceive; 2d) (Pual); 2d1) to be persuaded; 2d2) to be deceived
